_schema: qec_twin.code_status.v1 — hand-maintained status overlay for tools/gen_code_map.py. Keys = package paths relative to src/ (fully-qualified, e.g. 'qec_twin/forward', 'error_coupling_simulator/source'), or a module path for a per-module override. status in {ACTIVE, PLACEHOLDER, ARCHIVED, TOOLING}. gen_code_map.py DRIFT-CHECKS this against the code: add an entry when a new package appears, remove one when a package is deleted (both are flagged in CODE_MAP.md's DRIFT CHECK). '_'-prefixed keys are config, not packages.

_local_index._note: Curated CLUSTERS of load-bearing LOCAL-ONLY working code under gitignored outputs/ (NOT committed; present on the build workstation). Maintain the GLOBS (stable); gen_code_map auto-discovers the FILES matching them, so new nm_*/cert_*/quantum_bath_* appear without editing this. Globs are relative to the repo root. NOTE: source/ + oracles/ have been re-homed into src/error_coupling_simulator/ (MIGRATION P1); the outputs/teacher_prereg/ copies below are FROZEN LEGACY — the package is canonical.
